ideas.idea: Align robots.txt with geo policy by allowing AI search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) and blocking training crawlers
ideas.why: The config already declares search allow and training block, and robots.txt allows all by default; the GPTBot block is deliberate, so this misreads it as a conflict.

ideas.idea: Block additional training crawlers explicitly in robots.txt, since only GPTBot is blocked and a config file isn't a crawler mechanism
ideas.why: trainingCrawlers: block is only enforced for GPTBot in robots.txt, so adding other training user agents (e.g. CCBot, Google-Extended) would actually enforce the declared policy.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD (Bakery/LocalBusiness, Product, Course, Offer) to pages
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add address, opening hours, phone, ordering link and collection details to the homepage
ideas.why: The homepage mentions York and pre-order but has no address, hours or ordering link, so these facts are missing for people and machines.

ideas.idea: Add class details (dates, duration, price, location) and a booking link to classes.html, with matching structured data
ideas.why: The page says 'Book early' but offers no way to book or any specifics.

ideas.idea: Give breads.html a structured catalogue with names, descriptions, prices and availability, plus Product/Offer markup
ideas.why: The page only says 'over twenty loaves' and names two, so the catalogue content is thin and unspecific.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the allergen notice
ideas.why: The scoped data-nosnippet on the allergen notice is a deliberate, acceptable choice.

ideas.idea: Provide fuller allergen policy and item-level allergen info
ideas.why: The allergen text is only 'Contains gluten. Ask us about allergens.', so fuller allergen information would help users.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter metadata to pages
ideas.why: This applies to nearly any site and has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Remove the robots.txt disallow for /members/ and keep noindex, or protect it with authentication
ideas.why: The noindex plus disallow on the private members page is a deliberate choice, and the disallow is correct.

ideas.idea: Add thin-content expansion: sourcing, process, FAQs, testimonials, class policy
ideas.why: It rests on thin-page and no-FAQ folklore, which the brief rules out as problems.
